title: Yankee Akuyaku Reijou - Tensei Tenka Yuiga Dokuson
original_title: Yankee Akuyaku Reijou - Tensei Tenka Yuiga Dokuson
alt_titles: ヤンキー悪役令嬢　転生天下唯我独尊シリーズ
Motorcycle Gang Leader ♂ Reborn as a Villainess ♀
description:
Ryuji, the head of the legendary biker gang "Antoinette", is reincarnated in a different world after a motorcycle accident. As... a villainess!!! 
Ryuji is tangled in the troubles of the life of Elsa, the daughter of the Tsochuarch family, and is about to be executed?!
